title: It's not obvious before selecting it that a companion's grief-quest option like 'coax the old call out of him' or 'read the roll's cadence' only fully registers a piece of shared world-knowledge (like the recall's third note) once you take that specific action, even after two NPCs have already described/confirmed the same fact in conversation.
